# end

The key is  to customized the break date.

# assume myDate included the initial month break
myDate <- seq(as.Date("2000/1/1"), by="day", length.out=1000)

# method 1: use the default breaks
cut(myDate, breaks="3 months")

# method 2: use the customerized breaks
initialMonthBreak <- "12" # eg. "01", "02",...,"12"

yearStart <- format(myDate[1], "%Y") # 2000
dateStart <- as.Date(paste(yearStart, initialMonthBreak, "01", sep="-")) # 2000-12-01
dateAll <- seq(dateStart, myDate[length(myDate)], by="month")
ind <- dateAll[which(((1:length(dateAll)) %% 3) == 1)] # select the customerized breaks
breakDate <- c(min(myDate), ind[1:(length(ind)-1)], max(myDate)+1) # verify the final breaks

# make the customerized labels
breakYearIndx <- as.numeric(format(breakDate[2:length(breakDate)], "%Y"))
breakMonthIndex <- month.abb[as.numeric(format(breakDate[2:length(breakDate)], "%m"))]
breakLabels <- paste(breakYearIndx, breakMonthIndex, sep="-")

# customerized cut
cut(myDate, breaks=breakDate, labels=breakLabels)
# end
